question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The __ambiguous__ statement of the leader raised criticism among the public.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Clear)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ambiguous"** means something that is unclear, open to more than one interpretation, or difficult to understand. (अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example:** The instructions provided were ambiguous, leading to confusion among the participants.
 
 
 
• **"Clear"** refers to something that is easy to understand, free from ambiguity, and straightforward. (स्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher gave clear instructions on how to complete the assignment.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'ambiguous'** is **'clear'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Clear)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Confusing** (भ्रामक): Something that causes confusion or is difficult to understand.

 
 
• **Example:** The map was confusing, and we ended up taking the wrong route.
 
 
 
• **Disorganized** (अव्यवस्थित): Lacking structure or order; chaotic.
 
 
• **Example:** The office was so disorganized that it was hard to find any documents.
 
 
 
• **Puzzled** (हैरान): Feeling confused or uncertain about something.
 
 
• **Example:** He looked puzzled when asked about the sudden change in plans.
